text: Sarah has 15 apples. She gives 4 apples to her friend and buys 7 more. How many apples does Sarah have now?
A train travels at 60 miles per hour for 2.5 hours. How far does it travel?
A rectangle has a length of 12 cm and a width of 8 cm. What is its area?
John is twice as old as Mary. In 5 years, John will be 25. How old is Mary now?
A store sells pencils for $0.50 each and pens for $1.20 each. If Lisa buys 8 pencils and 5 pens, how much does she spend?
The sum of three consecutive integers is 72. What are the three integers?
A car uses 5 gallons of gas to travel 150 miles. How many gallons are needed to travel 360 miles?
A right triangle has legs of 9 cm and 12 cm. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
A pizza is cut into 8 equal slices. If 3 people each eat 2 slices, what fraction of the pizza is left?
Compound interest: $1000 invested at 5% annual interest compounded yearly. How much after 3 years?
A farmer has chickens and cows. There are 30 heads and 86 legs total. How many chickens and how many cows?
A pool can be filled by pipe A in 4 hours and pipe B in 6 hours. If both pipes are open, how long to fill the pool?
